said: The Board's real responses: H.10's pages recorded 2026-10-10 as received, each body gzipped; H.15's SDMX file and the zero curve's CSV recorded 2026-10-23 and trimmed to keep the repository small -- H.15's file to its 30 business-daily series in force and their observations from 2026-09-01, rezipped holding H15_data.xml alone; the zero curve's file to its notes, its header and the rows from 2026-09-01, gzipped -- every byte kept otherwise as received. The Board's site is public domain (it may be copied and distributed without permission, https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm), and the zero curve is the Board's staff's (Gurkaynak, Sack and Wright, 2006, FEDS 2006-28), so they are committed. Synthetic mode serves them, and the tests read them.
